stories.delivered_paragraph: Spotify added 1 million more premium subscribers than it had forecast in the second quarter, helping it deliver 14% revenue growth to €4.777 billion despite a slight shortfall in monthly-user growth. The company said its AI playlisting and remix tools have “strong momentum,” while spending on AI and marketing remains controllable; gross margin rose 193 basis points to 33.4%. The results suggest Spotify’s subscription gains are cushioning its push into new AI-driven products.

stories.delivered_paragraph: Lenovo has cut the price of its SteamOS-powered Legion Go S handheld to $635.54 with the code EXTRASAVEAFF, its lowest recorded price and far below its roughly $1,000 Best Buy price. The model uses AMD’s Z2 Go chip, an 8-inch 120Hz variable-refresh display and SteamOS, which reviewers found more appealing than the Windows version. The deal makes it a more direct alternative to Valve’s Steam Deck, particularly for players willing to lower settings in demanding games.

stories.delivered_paragraph: Sony Music has promoted longtime lawyer Stephanie Yu to general counsel and executive vice president of business and legal affairs, replacing Julie Swidler after her departure. Yu, who joined Sony in 2005, will oversee business, legal and government affairs and report to chairman Rob Stringer and COO Kevin Kelleher; Swidler spent 18 years in the top legal role. The appointment puts an experienced internal dealmaker in charge of a key function as the label navigates licensing, regulation and industry consolidation.

stories.delivered_paragraph: BMW is displaying Spider-Man: Brand New Day ads on the dashboard screens of eligible cars in more than 70 countries as part of a partnership with the Marvel film. stories.delivered_paragraph: The White House does not plan to publish its new voluntary framework for evaluating advanced AI models, Axios reported, instead sharing details only with companies involved in the process. Officials held staff-level meetings with industry Tuesday, while uninvited companies, outside researchers and US allies remain unclear on the framework’s standards and which “trusted partners” may gain early model access. The secrecy could limit outside scrutiny of a policy meant to shape AI security practices with global consequences.

stories.delivered_paragraph: President Volodymyr Zelensky shared video showing a Russian drone pursuing a street vendor in Ukraine’s Kherson region before exploding near him; the man survived with shrapnel wounds, concussion and trauma, a doctor said. stories.delivered_paragraph: French rescuers brought 173 migrants ashore at Boulogne-sur-Mer after the engine of their Channel-crossing boat caught fire, with 11 people suffering minor injuries. French prosecutors opened an investigation and an Egyptian national was taken into custody; authorities said the vessel left France Monday night and some passengers initially refused rescue assistance. The incident again underscores the lethal risks of small-boat crossings and the difficulty of preventing journeys organized by smuggling networks.

stories.delivered_paragraph: The Writers Guild of America will hold its 2027 awards ceremonies on February 13 at the Edison Ballroom in New York and the Fairmont Century Plaza in Los Angeles, with nominations due to be announced January 8. stories.delivered_paragraph: Brent crude fell almost 5% below $80 a barrel, a three-week low, after US officials said talks with Iran had advanced toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping. US West Texas Intermediate also dropped more than 5% to $76, though Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was progress rather than a final agreement. A reopening could ease a major supply disruption, but previous failed diplomacy has kept oil markets—and fuel prices—volatile.

stories.delivered_paragraph: The S&P 500 reached a fresh record even as some valuation measures suggest the index may look relatively cheap, creating conflicting signals for investors. stories.delivered_paragraph: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US joined Japan in buying yen to curb currency volatility and reduce risks to Asian markets.
